errors.what: Gear2/gear3 (blue/green compound shaft) rotate counter-clockwise, the same direction as the input gear1. Externally meshed gear2 should turn clockwise, so gear1 and gear2 co-rotate, which is wrong for a spur mesh. The green gear3 marker advances CCW (about 45 deg at t=1, 90 deg at t=2, about 155 deg at t=3.33).

Output gear4 (purple) rotates clockwise (marker sweeps right to down-right to down-left). It should turn counter-clockwise at omega/6, because gear3 turns CW and the next external mesh reverses it. The magnitudes of the ratios look right (1/2 and 1/6), but the direction of gear2, gear3 and gear4 is reversed.
